developments: Bitcoin rose to $64,014 on Kraken in the hour before the US open as Nasdaq futures climbed on Anthropic's debut, then slid to $62,711 after it and traded at about $62,985 at 16:30 UK.
Anthropic rang the Nasdaq opening bell and its shares became eligible to trade from 15:00 UK; perpetual futures had pointed to a price near $104, about 25% above the $83 offer price.
Binance won a worldwide freezing order in Abu Dhabi covering up to $6.5 billion of the October hack proceeds, with a hearing on 1 December over assets already frozen by 18 firms.
briefing.changed: The morning recovery faded: bitcoin gave back its overnight gains in US hours and is about 1% below the morning edition, close to the $62,000 level it tested last night. ZEC slipped about 3% to about $921.
briefing.question: Is cash moving into Anthropic shares at bitcoin's expense, or is bitcoin simply failing to follow tech higher?
briefing.watch: Thursday's ETF flows, out by tomorrow morning, and whether $62,000 holds into the US close at 21:00 UK. The next 🔴 event is the Fed decision on Wednesday 9 December at 19:00 UK.

lead.headline: Bitcoin fades after US open as Anthropic shares start trading
lead.standfirst: Bitcoin briefly topped $64,000 as tech futures rallied ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut, then gave the gains back once US trading began.
body: Bitcoin traded at about $62,985 on Kraken at 16:30 UK on Thursday, about 1% below the morning edition, after reaching $64,014 shortly before the US open and then falling to $62,711 in the following hour.

The morning rise came as Nasdaq futures climbed about 2% ahead of Anthropic's first day as a listed company, according to Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin Magazine and CoinDesk both linked bitcoin's move towards $64,000 to the lift in tech shares.

Anthropic's founders rang the Nasdaq opening bell, The Next Web reported, and shares were eligible to trade from 15:00 UK. Before the open, perpetual futures on the shares traded near $104, about 25% above the $83 offer price, CryptoTicker reported.

CoinDesk said analysts disagree on whether investors are selling bitcoin to buy the new shares. It also reported that US spot bitcoin funds have seen outflows on 12 of the past 14 days, and that the largest cluster of leveraged long positions that could be forced to close sits near $62,030.
In a speech on Thursday, Fed governor Philip Jefferson said a stronger reaction to inflation is warranted if expectations risk becoming unanchored, but gave no signal on December's decision.

headline: Bitcoin touched $64,000 before the US open on tech optimism around Anthropic's debut, then slipped back to about $63,000. Binance won a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order over the October hack.
spoken: Cryptonaire Post, afternoon edition. Bitcoin rose just above sixty four thousand dollars this morning as tech shares rallied ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut, then slipped back after the US open. It was about sixty three thousand dollars at half past four, close to last night's low of sixty two thousand. Anthropic's shares became tradable from three o'clock UK time. Binance won a worldwide court order freezing up to six and a half billion dollars of hacked funds. Zcash eased to about nine hundred and twenty dollars. Information only, not advice.

stories.title: Bitcoin tops $64,000 before the US open, then falls back to about $63,000
stories.why: Bitcoin hit $64,014 on Kraken in the 13:00 UK hour, then dropped to $62,711 after the 14:30 UK open and traded at about $62,985 at 16:30 UK. CoinDesk reported $181 million of liquidations in 24 hours, 77% of them longs, and the largest long liquidation cluster near $62,030. This adds that the overnight bounce did not survive US hours.

note.read: The morning flagged a pattern of overnight bounces fading in US hours, and today repeated it, which keeps $62,000 the level in focus.
note.alt: A move of about 2% from the high is ordinary for bitcoin and may be no more than profit-taking around a round number.
note.change: A break below $62,000, which could trigger the long liquidations clustered there, or a close back above $64,000.

stories.title: Anthropic rings the Nasdaq bell; shares tradable from 15:00 UK
stories.why: Nasdaq futures were up about 2% before the open, Yahoo Finance reported, and perpetual futures on the shares traded near $104 pre-market, about 25% above the $83 offer price, CryptoTicker reported. The offering was about six times oversubscribed.
stories.caveat: No reliable report of the first Nasdaq trade price could be confirmed before publication; the $104 figure is a derivatives indication, not the share price.

note.read: Bitcoin rose with tech futures before the debut and fell once US trading began, which fits the idea that the IPO is drawing attention and money rather than lifting all risk assets.
note.alt: Bitcoin's US-hours weakness may reflect continued ETF selling that has run for weeks, unrelated to the listing.
note.change: How ANT and the Nasdaq close at 21:00 UK, and whether Thursday's ETF flows worsen.

stories.title: Binance wins worldwide freezing order over $6.5 billion hack
stories.why: An Abu Dhabi court barred the attackers, linked by the FBI to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, from moving up to $6.5 billion, and ordered 18 firms including Circle and BitGo to keep specific assets frozen, CoinDesk reported. About $2.85 billion has been frozen or intercepted, and Tether froze over $1.56 billion of USDT. This adds the court order itself; the morning edition reported the asset schedule.
stories.caveat: CoinDesk gives $6.5 billion as the ceiling of the order; the hack itself has been reported at $6.3 billion.

stories.title: Fed's Jefferson: firmer response warranted if inflation expectations slip
stories.why: Governor Philip Jefferson said inflation was already above the 2% target when the energy shock hit, and that AI investment is adding to demand and inflation. He said if price pressures are contained it may be prudent to focus on job risks, and gave no hint on December.

stories.title: Zcash miners to vote on NU7.1 on-chain from Friday; ZEC eases to about $921
stories.why: The Zcash Foundation opened a pilot poll letting miners record views on the proposed NU7.1 upgrade inside the blocks they mine, from block 3,591,200 (about 00:00 UK on Friday) to about 02:59 UK on 1 December, closing with the community poll. ZEC traded at about $921 on Kraken at 16:30 UK, down about 3% on the morning edition.
stories.caveat: The Foundation's post does not describe what NU7.1 contains, and a sentiment poll does not itself decide an upgrade.

stories.title: Coinbase opens 10x spot margin to wealthy US clients
stories.why: Coinbase launched spot margin trading with up to 10x leverage on major assets for US 'eligible contract participants', generally people with over $10 million invested, Bitcoin Magazine reported. It adds another source of leverage to the US market, though not for retail or UK users.

explained.title: What a liquidation cluster is
body: Traders who borrow to bet on a rise must add money or be closed out if the price falls far enough. Exchanges do this automatically, selling their position. When many such positions share a similar trigger price, analysts call it a liquidation cluster.

If the price reaches the cluster, forced selling can push it lower still for a short time. CoinDesk put the largest long cluster on Binance near $62,030 today, just below the level bitcoin tested last night.

investigating: Where did Anthropic's shares first trade and close? No reliable first-trade report could be confirmed by 16:30 UK; the evening edition will check.
Did ETF selling continue on Thursday? Flow figures, out by tomorrow morning, would show whether outflows extended to a third day.
CoinDesk listed ZEC as the weakest of its top 100 tokens, down 14.4%, but did not give the period; Kraken shows a smaller daily move. A clear time frame would settle it.
